title: RecurringAlignment: Lexical Drift Detection and In-Context Realignment for AI-Assistant Conversations
description: A TypeScript toolkit that scores each assistant turn of a conversation for drift from a user-defined anchor (goals, constraints, persona, decisions) using TF-IDF/cosine similarity and rule heuristics, generates compact realignment prompts for in-context correction, and rebuilds a clean resume state after drift (Drift Replay). Includes a CLI, chat-completion middleware, and optional LLM judges.
